qualification: Offline diagnostics only; no paid calls or changes to benchmark scoring, frozen formats, or published search scores.
findings: Original-image and uploaded-image pixel box_2d requests are identical for all 50 images in each of MiniMax, Kimi and Nemotron; they are repeat observations, not independent format treatments.
MiniMax identical-prompt runs differ by 6.39 mAP50 points, demonstrating generation variability not captured by conditional image bootstrap.

Nemotron frequently disregards requested coordinate convention: offline reinterpretation of pixel-request responses as XYXY 0–1000 raises mAP50 from 1.97 to 52.79; reinterpreting YXYX-request responses as XYXY raises 2.97 to 53.84.
Changing only the denominator for saved Nemotron 0–999 outputs to 1000 changes mAP50 from 52.89 to 52.80; this does not support a confident native 999-grid claim.
Search includes wording and JSON-shape differences as well as coordinate differences. Same first 50 images are part of full 250-image benchmark, so selection is not held-out.
API success is not strict output-schema compliance; the shared historical parser accepts aliases such as bbox_2d.
